title: Direct calls with retained stack operands
summary: Extends a terminating internal-callee theorem to arguments followed by a caller stack suffix, preserving that suffix after the results.
premises: A terminating callee theorem on exactly its arguments
The function index is outside the import list
Argument count equals the function parameter count
The caller stack is the argument list followed by the identified suffix
result: The call terminates with results followed by the unchanged suffix and preserves the callee's store/result postcondition.
